skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Yukibare
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Yukibare. Suzuran's outfit on a winter morning trip to the shrine. The loose-fitting sleeves protect against the wind and snow, while the pleated front adds an exotic touch.
skins.quote: The girl's eyes reflect the color of the snow. She is pure and pristine like the new snow.

skins.name: Lostlands Flowering
skins.content: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Lostlands Flowering. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made with special materials suited for adapting to all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
skins.usage: One of Suzuran's special work outfits.
skins.quote: The colossi may long be in decline, but the smallest flowerbuds brim yet with hope.

skins.name: Spring Praise
skins.content: The Legend of Luo Xiaohei Collaborative Series/Spring Praise. Rustic apparel commonly seen in Terra's central regions. Simple and easygoing, hardy against wear and dirt. Best suited to journeys, outings, and other such daily activities.
skins.quote: Sunlight filters through the leaves, and she meanders about the trees with her newfound friend, her smile as beautiful and bright as a flower.
